visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a textured, layered mineral specimen sitting on a small white stand against a solid dark background. Large yellow and white Chinese characters appear at the top as a title card. (2) The camera moves to extreme macro close-ups, showcasing the intricate concentric patterns and metallic sheen of the rock under bright, white studio lighting. (3) A significant visual shift occurs as the lighting changes to ultraviolet (UV); the mineral begins to glow with a vibrant orange-brown and yellow fluorescence. (4) The shot transitions through several different angles and close-up views of the glowing mineral, emphasizing its layered, aggregate structure. (5) The lighting returns to standard white light for a final shot of the specimen while a decorative graphic with text information about the mineral's origin and the narrator's brand appears at the bottom.
